harnessNote: Final run09 capture driver compiled with package09. It uses the actual Eclipse Cmd+Shift+S Save All gesture. Prior coherent run08 used palette Save All and is retained separately; its exact manifest is controls/run08-manifest.json.
capture: Visible native Swing window; actual posted AWT key events; no mouse events; read-only assertions/snapshots; two unmodified frame PNGs. No human/manual or OS Robot claim.
bundleNote: Paths containing # identify exact text values in JSON bundles, not standalone files. Per-value hashes cover UTF-8 content; whole-file hashes are listed separately.
